name: Macro Tech Titan AI
author: macrotechtitan

sections.description:
Macro Tech Titan AI automatically creates blogs, jokes, news, tips, and weekly posts using the Perplexity AI API, helping keep your WordPress site fresh with minimal manual effort.

The plugin is designed to be easy to configure, even on a fresh WordPress installation. It supports scheduled publishing, SEO metadata generation.

Key Features

  • AI-generated blog content
  • Weekly automated posts
  • Perplexity AI API integration
  • SEO title and meta description generation
  • Google AdSense support
  • Scheduled content publishing

Features

1. General Settings – Manage Content Types

From the General Settings page, administrators can manage built-in AI content blocks.

The plugin provides 7 content types. Each content type includes:

  • Enable / Disable toggle
  • Description field
  • Day and time scheduling
  • Automatic content generation using Perplexity AI

  • Auto-generated shortcode and widget for embedding

  • All 7 content types can be enabled

Each enabled content type generates AI-based blog content automatically based on the configured schedule.

2. Post Settings – Automatic Weekly Blog Generator

The Post Settings page enables full automation for weekly WordPress post creation.

Configuration options include:

  1. Enable or disable weekly auto-post creation
  2. Select post creation day and time
  3. Assign post categories
  4. Assign post tags
  5. Give SEO title
  6. Give SEO meta description
  7. Generate full post content using Perplexity AI
  8. Featured image source selection:
  • Automatic (system-selected)
  • WordPress Media Library

At the scheduled time each week, the plugin publishes a complete, SEO-ready post automatically.

Shortcodes

Each content type provides its own shortcode, which is displayed inside the General Settings page and can be used in posts, pages, or widgets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open General Settings to configure content types and schedules
  4. Configure AdSense settings (optional)
  5. Configure weekly post automation in Post Settings
  6. Optional: Upgrade via Branding → Pro Version
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use Perplexity AI?

Yes. All AI-generated content is created using the Perplexity AI API.

Is there a free version?

Yes. The free version allows up to 2 content types.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Go to Branding → Pro Version, click Proceed to Payment, complete the Stripe checkout, and enter your emailed license key.

Is the generated content SEO-friendly?

Yes. The plugin automatically generates SEO titles and meta descriptions.
